items.title: Den er en av sentrums tristeste. Nå skal det skje noe i Schweigaards gate
items.excerpt: En trafikantgruppe skal få det bedre i gata. Premisset er at en annen trafikantgruppe ikke skal få det verre.

items.title: Dortmund og Ryerson rystet Bayern i thriller
items.excerpt: Dortmund og Julian Ryerson imponerte da de sikret 2-2 mot Bayern München etter dramatiske sluttminutter. items.title: Saints come from behind to beat in-form Gloucester
items.excerpt: Late tries from George Hendy and Rory Hutchison gift Northampton Saints victory over stubborn Gloucester.

items.title: Serbia after Vucic: The winners are losing patience
items.excerpt: After the Student List's election victory, Aleksandar Vucic's power apparatus is disintegrating. People want justice as soon as possible. But the eleciton losers still hold sway in the judiciary and administration.

items.title: World number one-bound Zverev loses to De Minaur
items.excerpt: Alexander Zverev loses his first match since securing the men's world number one ranking as he suffers a surprise defeat by Alex de Minaur in the semi-finals of the Vienna Open.

items.title: Clashes erupt between police and protesters in Paris
items.excerpt: Over 320,000 people protested around France in a third weekend of demonstrations against the rising cost of living and poor public services.

items.title: 'We came back from hell', say Ukrainians after years in Russia-occupied frontline city
items.excerpt: One evacuated couple says they crossed minefields in Oleshky in a search for food.
